description: Recovery corpus for AC-113: transcript shapes that were actually observed coming back from whisper-large-v3-turbo over the dictation corpus (Chinese edge-tts and English TTS). Each entry pairs the authored reference with the observed transcript, so identifier survival can be measured before and after repair on real failure shapes rather than on invented ones.

sources.sentences: 仓库外验证工装的 logs/quality-en.log（英文 o65/o45 场景的并排逐字记录，对应语料脚本 e01-e04）与 logs/test6-bias.log（中文 d01-d04 的 plain 列）。
sources.fragments: 同一批日志里逐字出现的标识符级渲染（logs/test3-final.log 的 critical-token 列表、logs/test5-noise-asr.log 的降噪场景）。
sources.note: 句子条目的参考与转写是日志逐字；片段条目只保留被观测到的那个 token 形态，句框在日志里各自不同，故不补句子。
